description: Home, draw and away win chances and expected goals for one fixture, with the model version and the time the forecast was generated. Use this when you only need the headline chances for a match. Use get_case_file instead for the score grid and the reasoning, or get_betting_picks for tactica.'s recommended bets. Read-only; the latest forecast for the fixture. Paid: 0.25 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.

fixtureId.description: Required. The tactica. fixture id, copied from the fixtureId field of list_fixtures. Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

name: get_match_forecast
title: Get a match forecast
